title: Reheating the Walmart Hot Deli Items
description: How to eat and reheat the Walmart hot deli wings, wrap, and turnover.

ingredients.item: Freshness Guaranteed hot ranch-seasoned jumbo wings

steps: Hot ranch wings: eat hot right away. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

To reheat wings: Air Fry mode 375°F preheated, wings on a rack over a sheet pan, 8 to 12 min, flip once. Done when sizzling and hot through (165°F). Microwave works in a pinch (1 to 2 min, covered) but the skin goes soft.
Chicken spicy mustard wrap: made to eat cold. Keep refrigerated until eating.

Pepperoni and cheese turnover: best in the oven. Air Fry mode 350°F preheated, 8 to 10 min, until the crust is crisp and the cheese is bubbling at the ends. If the top darkens fast, lay foil loosely over it. Microwave shortcut: 45 to 75 seconds (softer crust).
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R1

not_healthy: Store deli fried and seasoned foods are high in sodium.
Wings with skin, pepperoni and cheese add saturated fat.
Pepperoni is processed meat, and the turnover is refined flour.
